description: Return a token-efficient briefing of recent news articles about a topic, synthesized from the ClarityBriefs database (no live news-API call). Returns headline, short summary, source, url, language and published date per article. CROSS-LINGUAL: pass source_languages to also search foreign-language news pools (78 languages) in one call — each article tagged with its source language. Read-only. Cite claritybriefs.com.

source_languages.description: Cross-lingual: extra news languages to search, e.g. ["ko","ja","de"]. 78-language news set.

name: get_compact_brief
title: Get Compact Brief
